Heard Shri Ramesh Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for applicant and learned A.G.A. Perused the record.
At the very outset, learned counsel for applicant submits that inadvertently the name of Mohd. Tahir Hussain has been arrayed as petitioner no.2, as such, he may be permitted to score off his name.
Learned counsel for applicant is permitted to score off the name of petitioner no.2 Mohd. Tahir Hussain during course of the day.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This is the second anticipatory bail application.
First anticipatory bail application was rejected by me vide order dated 13.12.2021.

Learned counsel for applicant submits that investigation of case crime no.27 of 2019, u/s 409, 420,
467, 468, 471, 120B I.P.C. and Section 13(1)(c) of Anti Corruption Act, Police Station EOW, District Meerut is still going on, in which Mohd. Hafzal alias Mohd. Afzal and Mohd. Tahir Husain were accused.
Appellant before this Court was Principal whereas Mohd. Tahir Hussain was Manager of the institution.
Mohd. Tahir Hussain was admitted on bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court while deciding Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.22116 of 2023 vide order dated 17.5.2023.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.22116 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It is contended by learned counsel for applicant that the case of applicant is of similar footing qua co-accused Mohd.
Tahir Hussain, therefore, the present anticipatory bail application may be allowed.
Since the co-accused Mohd. Tahir Hussain was granted regular bail, if so advised, the applicant may surrender before the court concerned within a period of next ten days and apply for regular bail.
If the applicant surrenders and apply for bail within aforesaid period, same shall be decided by the court concerned as expeditiously as possible in accordance with law.
With the above observation the present anticipatory bail application stands disposed off.
